internal_sales.list.quote.title: Internal sales quotes
internal_sales.list.quote.description: Quotes the head office issues to a branch; the buyer is a related organization from the organization tree. This entry lists internal documents only — external ones live under External sales in the Export operations group. Not the proforma invoice (PI) that backs a collection. Lines reference the app-owned product master and stay editable in this module. Two ways to order: “New order from this quote” keeps the quote and lets you edit the result; “Convert to order” converts in place, so the quote no longer exists.
internal_sales.list.order.title: Internal sales orders (PO)
internal_sales.list.order.description: Sales orders the head office issues to a branch; the buyer is a related organization from the organization tree. This entry lists internal documents only — external ones live under External sales in the Export operations group. Fulfilment (shipments, invoices, payments) still runs on the installed sales chain.
internal_sales.form.linePrecision: Line {line}: quantity and unit price accept at most 4 decimal places.
internal_sales.list.actions.convertConfi: Convert this quote into an order?
The quote becomes an order in place: it keeps its lines and its buyer snapshot and gets a new order number, but the quote itself no longer exists — this cannot be undone.
internal_sales.list.actions.sendDone: Quote sent — the acceptance link went out to the buyer.
internal_sales.list.actions.sendDialogTi: Send this quote to the buyer?
internal_sales.list.actions.sendDialogBo: The quote is marked as sent, gets an acceptance link for the buyer and an email is queued. Editing the quote afterwards returns it to draft and invalidates the link.
internal_sales.list.actions.sendEmailHin: The address comes from the quote's buyer email; fill “Buyer email” on the quote when it is empty.
internal_sales.list.actions.sendNoEmail: Fill in the buyer email on this quote before sending it.

internal_sales.list.actions.cancelConfir: A canceled document cannot be sent, ordered or allocated to a shipment — this cannot be undone.

internal_sales.list.externalOrder.title: External sales orders (PO)
internal_sales.list.externalQuote.descri: Quotes a branch issues to local customers; the buyer is one of this organization's external customers. This entry lists external documents only — internal ones live under Internal sales in the Export operations group.
internal_sales.list.externalOrder.descri: Sales orders a branch issues to local customers; the buyer is one of this organization's external customers. This entry lists external documents only — internal ones live under Internal sales in the Export operations group.
